messages:
Sara: Paging on-call — seeing a spike of 5xx on /v1/generate (us-west-2) starting ~2026-03-17T14:02 PDT, currently ~18-22% error rate. Customers report failed completions.
Mike: Thanks — I'm on it, grabbing traces and genqueue stats. Any customer-facing comms drafted yet?
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT: routing=us-west-2, service=api-gen, severity=high, metric=5xx_rate, started=2026-03-17T14:02:23Z
Mike: Early signal looks like a downstream redis timeout causing retries to amplify. Repro on staging with heavy concurrent requests.
Lina: Support roundup: Customer tickets: 6 high-severity so far (IDs: 2321, 2324, 2330...). Mostly timeouts during longer generations. We should put a short ‘we are investigating’ on the status page asap.
Eli: Draft for status page (short):
```
Initial update (14:10 UTC): We are investigating elevated error rates for text generation in our us-west region. Some requests may fail with 5xx errors or timeouts. Our engineering team is actively triaging; we will post updates here every 15 minutes. No broad data loss reported.
```
Sara: Love concise. Add estimated impact: "affecting a subset of generation requests in us-west" and mention workaround: "retryable — clients may see improved results after a short delay"?
Eli: Updated copy:
```
Initial update (14:10 UTC): We are investigating elevated 5xx error rates for text generation in the us-west (us-west-2) region. A subset of generation requests may fail or time out. Engineering is actively triaging. If possible, please retry requests after a short delay; clients configured for automatic retries may see improved success rates. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.
```
Anya: Quick legal check: fine to advise retries as a workaround. Avoid promising timelines. Recommend we do not call out specific infra component (redis) until we confirm root cause.
Mike: Acknowledged — will keep infra details internal until RCA. Working on a mitigation: reducing upstream retry fanout and applying a short backoff in the request router.
Lina: Support ready to paste the statuspage line into customer responses once published. Also prepping canned reply: "We're investigating elevated errors in us-west; engineering is working on mitigation. If you continue to see failures after 5 minutes, reply here and we'll escalate."
Eli: Can someone approve publish? Need a +1 from on-call and comms.
Mike: +1 to publish the initial update as worded.
Sara: +1 — publish now.
statuspage-bot: Status Page: POST /incidents -> created incident ics-20260317-usw-gen. Initial message published (14:12 UTC).
Eli: Copy of what went live:
"We are investigating elevated 5xx error rates for text generation in the us-west (us-west-2) region. A subset of generation requests may fail or time out. Engineering is actively triaging. If possible, please retry requests after a short delay. Updates every ~15 minutes."
Lina: Pasted into active tickets and customer DMs. Marking the impacted customers list and escalating one enterprise customer to account exec.
Mike: Mitigation applied at 14:20 UTC: reduced upstream retries and enabled short router backoff. Error rate dropped to ~6% in the next 3 minutes. Continuing to monitor.
Eli: Draft update 2 for status page (14:30 UTC):
```
Update (14:30 UTC): We have applied rate-limiting and retry-reduction mitigations which have reduced the error rate. Error rates are improving but not fully resolved; some requests may still fail. We continue to monitor.
```
Anya: OK. No legal flags.
Sara: Post that update and call out that we'll follow up with a resolved notice when stabilized.
statuspage-bot: Status Page: PATCH /incidents/ics-20260317-usw-gen -> update posted (14:31 UTC).
Mike: Follow-up: by 14:35 UTC error rate dropped to <1% and tail latency normalized. All routing queues look healthy. Rolling back the temporary backoff in 10m unless we see regression.
Eli: Draft resolved notice:
```
Resolved (14:45 UTC): The issue impacting generation in us-west (us-west-2) has been resolved. Error rates and latency have returned to normal. We identified the root cause as an interaction between upstream retry behavior and a transient downstream latency spike; a full post-incident review and RCA will follow. We apologize for the disruption.
```
Anya: Slight tweak — remove specific infra phrasing from public resolved copy: change root cause line to: "we identified contributing factors related to retry amplification and transient downstream latency; an RCA will follow."
Eli: Updated resolved copy ready.
Lina: Support: I'll follow up with impacted customers individually with the final note and link to the status update.
statuspage-bot: Status Page: PATCH /incidents/ics-20260317-usw-gen -> resolved notice published (14:46 UTC).
Sara: Thanks team. Oncall handoff in 20m, leaving notes in the incident log. Please add any postmortem action items to the ticket: - harden retry controls - add generation-specific circuit breaker - improve alerting thresholds for KV latency spikes.
Mike: Adding monitoring runbook edits and alerts. Will own the RCA.
Eli: I'll create the public incident summary doc and link to statuspage entry.
Lina: Closing customer tickets where appropriate; keeping one high-touch open for the enterprise customer.
incident-bot: Incident closed on status page by statuspage-bot (14:46 UTC). Incident duration ~44 minutes.
Sara: Good job — short, accurate comms made a big difference. :thumbsup:
